column2: G10 (amendment A1, spec section 21) counts synchronization events with exactly one GPU claim in flight, so results per wake = 1 on both sides by construction; it cannot show one completion scan covering many results. Host spin cost (empty completion polls per GPU result) is reported, not gated; both RES-1 and SEQ spin while one claim is in flight, and the spin rate varied about 6x between runs with identical clocks (attempt 1), so it is not claimed to be small or stable.
